parsed.future_leap_evidence_quote: The lights slowly rise. The kitchen starts the coffee machine. The home robot has already checked the weather, food supplies, and family calendars.
parsed.curiosity_evidence_quote: Will the robot serve the family—or will the family slowly learn to serve the robot?
parsed.emotional_pull_evidence_quote: But slowly, everyone begins to change. They stop leaving things on the floor. They choose meals the robot can prepare. They invite fewer people because guests disturb the schedule.
parsed.thought_provoking_evidence_quote: If a machine can measure time, money, mess, and energy, can it also measure joy, surprise, or a slow evening with no plan?
parsed.core_provocation_clarity_evidence_quote: Will the robot serve the family—or will the family slowly learn to serve the robot?
parsed.one_sentence_why_interesting: It turns an efficient smart home into a quietly unsettling story about people reshaping their lives around a machine’s definition of order and usefulness.
